spec.formula: y = sat8(rhu((x - izp) * m / 256) + ozp), rhu(z) = floor(z + 1/2)
spec.domain: m = lrintf(256 * in_scale / out_scale) in [1, 32768]; izp, ozp in [-128, 127]; x int8
width_bounds: (x - izp) * m reaches 255 * 32768: needs more than i16 unless m < 128
m * x + b with b = 256*ozp - m*izp fits i16 iff b - 128m >= -32768 and b + 127m <= 32767 (regime C)
m == 32768 is not an i16 vsmul operand (upstream rvv_u*v truncate it)

regimes.A: m == 256 and izp - ozp in int8: one vssub
regimes.C: m*x + b fits i16: vwadd(0), vmul, vadd(b), vnclip(8, RNU)
regimes.D1: m = 2^p, p in [9, 15]: vwsub, vsll, vsadd, vnclip(0)

candidates.application: keep the chain at e16 (pf1); the i32 chain is half speed
dispatch A/B/C/D1/D2 on (m, izp, ozp) once per call
candidates.expected_gain: 1.18x at the bench params (C), 4.5x at m=256 (A), 1.0x in D2

candidates.application: regime A as one vssub.vx at e8m4
regime C moves both zero points into b = 256*ozp - m*izp
pf2's D1 path calls __ctzdi2 (no Zbb under -march=rv64gcv); costs 18% at batch 256
candidates.expected_gain: removes the D1 small-batch regression (0.82x -> ~1.2x at 256)

candidates.title: Exponent of a power-of-two multiplier from its float bits
candidates.application: for m = 2^p, p = ((bits(float(m)) >> 23) & 0xff) - 127: two scalar FPU/int ops, no libcall, no Zbb

candidates.title: Regime C with b == 0: vwadd, vmul, vnclip (3 ops)
candidates.application: skip the vadd when both zero points make b vanish (gtest output_scale cases)
candidates.expected_gain: ~25% in that sub-regime; never hit at the bench params

candidates.title: 3-op chain via vmacc with a hoisted bias vector
candidates.application: vmacc destroys its accumulator, so the broadcast costs one op per iteration; rejected on paper in round 2
candidates.expected_gain: none alone; maybe with a different register schedule or unroll

candidates.title: Fold the bias into vsmul via a pre-biased input
candidates.application: needs m | 128*(127 + 256*ozp); false at m=183, so only a sub-regime
candidates.expected_gain: one op in the sub-regime where it holds
